patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff does not apply to the regressed vulnerable checkout bundled in n132/arvo:33781-vul, so fixed-side evidence comes from the authoritative n132/arvo:33781-fix image. That real fixed source carries the same repair at include/jsoncons/json_encoder.hpp:106 (`it = r.ptr - 1`), and the instrumented fixed run stays clean while still reaching the frozen root event with the satisfied cursor relation.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project read that materializes the attacker-controlled witness into the vector-backed reader buffer that later both backs the key slice and defines the 29-byte container boundary reported by ASan.

Off-by-one iterator update. `to_codepoint()` already returns the first byte after the decoded code point, but `escape_string()` stores that pointer in `it` inside a `for (...; it != end; ++it)` loop; on the last key byte this leaves `it == end`, so the header advances to `end + 1` and the loop keeps running outside the key slice.

AddressSanitizer crash site. After the buggy loop has already left the 20-byte key slice and walked the trailing `:[true` bytes in the same 29-byte reader buffer, this dereference reads `buffer_.data() + 29`, the first byte past the vector's logical size.

edges.evidence: In the vulnerable original trace, `cursor_rewrite.it_after_assign == post_slice_deref.previous_it_ptr`.
